No contents or copyright pages are present. 
Some pages are feint due to occasional light print impressions. 
Pagination generally reflects the individual issues bound together in this volume but occasional irregularities occur.
Tight binding has meant some print falls in the gutter in this volume 
with the pages cut close to the text causing occasional cropping.
